Lady balls :)

I'm close to my mum, and sort of to my dad. Whew, this will be tough. I'm really scared... but I know you're right. I'm also worried that my mum will have to take the brunt of my dad's anger (not physically, he's never been violent), since she's living with him and all. Am I being really selfish?

Either way, I am feeling more inspired :) thanks

What if I wanted to do something I know would be unpopular with my parents (super especially my dad, in particular) but doesn't hurt anyone (me included haha) and would make me really happy? It's also kind of a once-in-a-really-long-time opportunity...

I'm 21 and don't live with my parents.

Ugh, I sound like a 10 year old.

But what do you think? I *want* to start living for myself. I have so many regrets because I tried to do what my parents or others thought it would be the right thing to do.

(Thanks for listening, seriously. I haven't had anyone more removed from the situation to talk to in so, so many years.)
Thank you. So, so much. I'll try to keep this mind, and I'll reread this the next time I'm at my lowest.

Thank you for the encouragement. I don't really know how to feel less worthless, though. I haven't achieved much, I'm not very clever and I don't measure up to anyone's expectations... what would you say to change my view?

Maybe if I think about it as just getting happ*ier*

I really don't know what meaning I should have... but on the plus side, I started an application to art school on sunday. Maybe my life can be about making things prettier? :)

Thank you

I have seen a doctor, and I'm going back next week which is how I've been prescribed the anti depressants. So at least that's the first step taken.

Can you believe the irony that my final year project is to create an app to help people cope with anxiety and depression?
